# ProDocify Project Progress Recap
**Date:** May 13, 2026 | **Session:** Development Session 1

---

## ✅ Completed Achievements

### 1. Project Planning & Architecture
- Created comprehensive `project-planning.md` document
- Defined tech stack: **Next.js** (frontend), **NestJS** (backend), **PostgreSQL** (database), **Prisma** (ORM)
- Outlined design patterns, security protocols, authentication strategies
- Planned database schema and real-time collaboration approach
- Documented roadmap, vulnerabilities, and future enhancements

### 2. Backend Infrastructure (NestJS)
- **Project Setup:**
  - Scaffolded NestJS project with TypeScript
  - Configured `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `tsconfig.build.json`
  - Added dev/build/start scripts

- **Dependencies Installed:**
  - NestJS core modules
  - Prisma ORM (`@prisma/client`)
  - Validation libraries (`class-validator`, `class-transformer`)
  - Auth packages (JWT, Passport)
  - ESLint, Prettier, TypeScript tooling

- **Core Modules Created:**
  - `AppModule` with global configuration
  - `PrismaModule` - database service (global, exportable)
  - `AuthModule` - placeholder auth controller/service
  - `DocumentsModule` - full CRUD endpoints for documents
  - `FoldersModule` - full CRUD endpoints for folders

- **API Routes Mapped:**
  - `GET /api` - health check
  - `POST /api/auth/login` - placeholder auth
  - `GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/documents*` - document operations
  - `GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/folders*` - folder operations

- **Build Status:** TypeScript compiles cleanly ✓

### 3. Database & ORM
- **Prisma Schema Created:**
  - `User` model
  - `Folder` model with relationships
  - `Document` model with owner and folder references
  - All with proper timestamps (createdAt, updatedAt)

- **Prisma Setup:**
  - Configured PostgreSQL datasource
  - Generated Prisma Client successfully
  - Created `.env` file with database configuration

### 4. Data Transfer Objects (DTOs)
- **DocumentDTO:**
  - `CreateDocumentDto` - title, content, folderId, ownerId
  - `UpdateDocumentDto` - all fields optional

- **FolderDTO:**
  - `CreateFolderDto` - name, ownerId
  - `UpdateFolderDto` - name optional

- All DTOs use `class-validator` decorators for input validation

### 5. Service & Controller Layer
- **DocumentsService:** findAll, findOne, create, update, remove
- **DocumentsController:** RESTful endpoints with proper decorators
- **FoldersService:** findAll, findOne, create, update, remove
- **FoldersController:** RESTful endpoints with proper decorators
- All services inject PrismaService for data access

## 🔧 Development Quick Start

### Backend
```bash
# Install dependencies
npm install --prefix "d:\Git Projects\ProDocify\backend"

# Generate Prisma client
npm run prisma:generate --prefix "d:\Git Projects\ProDocify\backend"

# Run migrations (after setting DATABASE_URL)
npm run prisma:migrate:dev --prefix "d:\Git Projects\ProDocify\backend"

# Start dev server
npm run dev --prefix "d:\Git Projects\ProDocify\backend"

# Build for production
npm run build --prefix "d:\Git Projects\ProDocify\backend"
```

### Key Commands
- Build: `npm run build --prefix "d:\Git Projects\ProDocify\backend"`
- Lint: `npm run lint --prefix "d:\Git Projects\ProDocify\backend"`
- Prisma Studio: `npx prisma studio --prefix "d:\Git Projects\ProDocify\backend"`
